bounded_negative.analysis_method: Apply the accepted central-v2 capability disposition for SPSG bounded-negative evidence.
bounded_negative.decision_rule: Set the central cap to zero with a not-required named-secondary disposition; do not interpret the no-contact stratum as SPSG evidence.
bounded_negative.observed_range_or_uncertainty: The accepted pilot marks evidence.bounded_negative not required for the central experiment.
bounded_negative.rationale: This prevents an obsolete v1 negative cap from being promoted into central v2.

capture_stride.analysis_method: Read the configured fixed-step capture stride from every accepted issue-44, issue-50 and issue-51 physical pilot capture.
capture_stride.decision_rule: Freeze the sole demonstrated positive integer stride.
capture_stride.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Observed stride range [1, 1] across 11 accepted non-final Unity captures.
capture_stride.rationale: Stride 1 retains every fixed-step frame record and matches the accepted exporter and derivation evidence.

motion_thresholds.analysis_method: Retain the shared numeric inputs from both accepted derivation specifications and their positive, negative and boundary adjudications.
motion_thresholds.decision_rule: Use the exact common accepted thresholds.
motion_thresholds.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Linear speed squared threshold 0.0001 and absolute angular speed threshold 0.01 degrees/second each passed two boundary windows in the accepted evidence; no broader sensitivity interval was accepted.
motion_thresholds.rationale: These values jointly define steady-state and unsupported stationary/floating-body labels.

noncentral_dispositions.analysis_method: Copy accepted issue-51 secondary and out-of-scope dispositions.
noncentral_dispositions.decision_rule: Keep named-secondary and out-of-scope items quota-free and excluded predicates unavailable rather than false.
noncentral_dispositions.observed_range_or_uncertainty: No non-central capability was promoted or used to pass the representative audit.
noncentral_dispositions.rationale: The production parameter plan remains bound to the approved central experiment.

penetration_tolerance.analysis_method: Retain the accepted excess-penetration threshold after exact re-derivation of positive, negative and threshold-boundary witnesses.
penetration_tolerance.decision_rule: Freeze 0.006 Unity units and use a strict separation < -tolerance comparison.
penetration_tolerance.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Accepted contact minima span approximately -0.043324 to -0.004999995 Unity units; the 0.006 tolerance passed two crossing windows and incomplete-evidence invalidation.
penetration_tolerance.rationale: This is the empirically accepted geometric threshold for the central endpoint label.

replay_tolerances.analysis_method: Retain the comparison bounds from the accepted version-bounded replay determination.
replay_tolerances.decision_rule: Freeze those exact comparison maxima within the accepted version envelope.
replay_tolerances.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Four of four replay captures passed with maximum relative fixed-step delta 1 and contact-separation delta 0.001; no retries or unavailable components occurred.
replay_tolerances.rationale: Production replay must not silently relax the pilot-accepted deterministic comparison contract.

retry_policy.analysis_method: Inspect all pilot retry decisions and permanent/transient classifications.
retry_policy.decision_rule: Freeze an empty transient retry map and one attempt per intervention.
retry_policy.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Zero retries were accepted; four runtime failures were permanent and one mutation was invalidated/quarantined.
retry_policy.rationale: No non-final pilot record justifies a positive transient retry count.

rollout_ceiling.analysis_method: Measure last retained fixed step minus pre-intervention fixed step for all 11 accepted physical pilot captures.
rollout_ceiling.decision_rule: Round twice the observed maximum span (582) upward to the next 100 fixed steps.
rollout_ceiling.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Observed terminal spans [227, 291] fixed steps; no rollout_ceiling termination was observed and production tails are uncertain.
rollout_ceiling.rationale: A 600-step ceiling gives an explicit conservative margin without reusing the unrelated v1 ceiling or consulting final data.

stability_window.analysis_method: Compare the accepted macro debounce and physical-violation stability-window specifications and their boundary adjudications.
stability_window.decision_rule: Freeze the common accepted two-step window.
stability_window.observed_range_or_uncertainty: Both accepted specifications use exactly two consecutive fixed steps; each passed two boundary windows.
stability_window.rationale: A different window would invalidate both accepted central derivation authorities.

support_threshold.analysis_method: Retain the engine-authoritative support direction threshold exercised by accepted persistent-support and support-change records.
support_threshold.decision_rule: Freeze the accepted exporter threshold; changing it requires a new plan and semantic adjudication.
support_threshold.observed_range_or_uncertainty: The accepted physics-v2 exporter used a strict vertical contact-normal component threshold of 0.5; issue 51 records no alternate threshold sensitivity.
support_threshold.rationale: Central supports labels must preserve the pilot-accepted engine meaning.

termination_vocabulary.analysis_method: Take the three terminal reasons demonstrated by the accepted pilot and add only the specification-required numeric safety ceiling.
termination_vocabulary.decision_rule: Close the vocabulary to the three accepted classes plus rollout_ceiling; treat other exits as failures.
termination_vocabulary.observed_range_or_uncertainty: level_clear, level_fail and stable_entered were observed; rollout_ceiling was not observed and is therefore non-quota-bearing.
termination_vocabulary.rationale: The vocabulary covers accepted engine termination and bounded execution without converting capture/operator failure into scientific termination.
